page_title: TOU 1-2 LIL | Toulouse v Lille 12/04/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+3' Guillaume Restes is equal to the effort from the edge of the box by Osame Sahraoui (Lille), pushing the ball around the post to safety.
90' 5 additional min. will be played.
89' Toulouse take a short corner kick.
88' One of the Lille players tripped an opponent and conceded a foul.
87' Carles Martinez decides to make a substitution. Vincent Sierro will be replaced by Miha Zajc (Toulouse).
87' The substitution has been made. Noah Edjouma (Toulouse) has replaced Gabriel Suazo.
86' Lille have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
85' Ethan Mbappe (Lille) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.
85' Ethan Mbappe (Lille) goes into the referee's book. Yellow card.
85' Ethan Mbappe (Lille) whips in the resulting set piece but it's cleared. The referee points to the corner flag and Lille will take a corner.
84' Bruno Genesio has decided to substitute Mathias Fernandez-Pardo and he is replaced by Ethan Mbappe (Lille).
84' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Aissa Mandi leaves the pitch and Thomas Meunier (Lille) comes on.
80' What a chance that is! Djibril Sidibe swings the ball into the box, and Frank Magri (Toulouse) gets in front of his man and powers his header just over the bar.
77' Vincent Sierro (Toulouse) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Jerome Brisard blows his whistle for a foul.

77' The goalkeeper made a fine save to prevent Cristian Casseres (Toulouse) from converting his header after a dangerous cross. The ball went into the middle of the goal, where the goalkeeper was standing.
76' Toulouse continue the game with a quickly taken free kick.
75' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Ayyoub Bouaddi (Lille) comes onto the pitch for Hakon Arnar Haraldsson.
74' One of the Toulouse players unfairly tackled his opponent and conceded a foul.
72' Djibril Sidibe (Toulouse) strikes from the edge of the box, but hits it really poorly and sends the ball way over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Lille will have a goal kick.
71' That's a clear yellow card. Alexsandro (Lille) goes into the book.
70' A corner kick by Toulouse is thwarted by the well prepared Lucas Chevalier (Lille).
70' Charlie Cresswell (Toulouse) is adjudged offside.
70' Yann Gboho (Toulouse) is unlucky with a low drive from the edge of the box. A decent save by Lucas Chevalier stops the ball from hitting the middle of the net. Now Toulouse have a corner.

69' Charlie Cresswell (Toulouse) rises highest from the corner to head at goal, but his effort towards the bottom left corner is brilliantly kept out by the goalkeeper. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Toulouse.
68' The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Toulouse.
67' Chuba Akpom (Lille) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
65' Referee Jerome Brisard has finally had enough of Carles Martinez and brandishes a yellow card at him!
64' Charlie Cresswell (Toulouse) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Jerome Brisard had an easy-decision to make.
64' Toulouse concede a free kick after one of their players holds onto an opposition player.
63' Bruno Genesio has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Osame Sahraoui (Lille) replacing Mitchel Bakker.
63' Substitution. Jonathan David leaves the pitch and is replaced by Chuba Akpom (Lille).
62' Jerome Brisard interrupts the game. One of the players from Toulouse won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair. Lille have a free kick.
61' Guillaume Restes (Toulouse) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
60' That will be all from Rafik Messali who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Joshua King (Toulouse).
60' Guillaume Restes (Toulouse) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
57' A player from Lille brings down an opponent and commits a foul.
55' One of the Toulouse players is in on goal but gets upended by the defender in the box. That could be a penalty, but the ref says NO! Play continues.
49' Mark McKenzie (Toulouse) commits a foul after making a slide tackle on his opponent.
47' Benjamin Andre (Lille) tries to take the opposition by surprise with a quick free kick into the box.
47' Poor challenge! Cristian Casseres (Toulouse) is penalised for tripping and Jerome Brisard blows his whistle. It's a free kick to Lille, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
46' The whistle blows and Jerome Brisard starts the second half.
45+5' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.

45+4' 1 - 2 Mitchel Bakker (Lille) displays what a brilliant free kick master he is, especially from this distance. He hits the ball very well and scores with a low shot inside the left post, leaving the keeper helpless.
45+3' Mitchel Bakker (Lille) takes the ball and sets it for the free kick.
45+2' Andre Gomes (Lille) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Jerome Brisard stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning.
45' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.

42' 1 - 1 Rafik Messali produces a beautiful lofted cross into the box, where Charlie Cresswell (Toulouse) rises high to head the ball into the left side of the goal and beyond the goalkeeper. He makes it 1:1.
40' Rafik Messali (Toulouse) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
36' Jerome Brisard blows his whistle and signals a foul after Gabriel Suazo (Toulouse) brought his opponent down. There is a free kick near the sideline to Lille.
35' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Toulouse, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
34' A player from Lille takes his opponent down, the referee blows his whistle for a foul. Free kick. Toulouse will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
34' Jonathan David (Lille) leaps high to meet a lofted pass inside the six-yard box, but his header flies yards over the crossbar.
27' Jerome Brisard blows his whistle for a foul after Vincent Sierro (Toulouse) hacks down one of his opponents. A free kick has been awarded to Lille.
25' Benjamin Andre (Lille) is penalised after knocking an opponent down. Toulouse are awarded the free kick.

21' 0 - 1 What a beautiful moment! Mathias Fernandez-Pardo (Lille) got to the ball and unleashed a strong shot from distance. It turned out to be a good decision as his effort found its way into the top left corner. Guillaume Restes just shakes his head in disbelief. The score changes to 0:1.
20' Bafode Diakite (Lille) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Jerome Brisard blows for a foul. Toulouse are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
18' The free kick from long range, taken by Lille, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
18' A player from Toulouse pulled an opponent down, forcing the referee to blow his whistle. Lille are awarded a free kick.
12' The linesman signals that Hakon Arnar Haraldsson (Lille) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
11' Handball by Benjamin Andre (Lille).
9' A player from Toulouse commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
9' The ball goes out of play. Toulouse are awarded a corner kick.
8' OFF THE POST! Frank Magri (Toulouse) takes a shot from outside the box and hits the right post!
6' What a strike! Vincent Sierro (Toulouse) hits the left post from the free kick.
6' Vincent Sierro (Toulouse) will take the free kick.
6' Bafode Diakite (Lille) performs a sliding tackle but catches his opponent's legs. The referee blows his whistle for an infringement. Toulouse will take a free kick.
3' It's a nice effort by Yann Gboho (Toulouse) from the edge of the box, but it's low towards the middle of the goal and straight down the throat of Lucas Chevalier. Easy save.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
The players are out at last! Lille will take the kick-off.
Jerome Brisard will supervise the game today.
